original_pre_race_assessment.summary: Sky Safari won this race last year and the Winter Derby here. At 9 st 2 lb she gives Enchanted Queen only 2 lb despite a 12 lb higher official rating. Kon Tiki is a Group 3 mile winner, unbeaten in two AW starts, and gives 7 lb for a 13 lb rating advantage.
original_pre_race_assessment.counterargument: Enchanted Queen has won both starts for George Boughey readily on AW and improved sharply at Wolverhampton. She is lightly raced and may bridge the class gap; her 94 rating is not a ceiling.
original_pre_race_assessment.rival_limitations: Sky Safari must reproduce her winter level after three less successful turf/Tapeta runs; Kon Tiki must rebound from her last two runs and carries her penalty. Pacific Mission, rated 101 at the same 9 st, brings recent Listed thirds but drops back from 1m2f. Aviatrice won the Dundalk Listed Cooley but gives 5 lb and needs more. American Gal and Song N Dance have credible Listed placings but less persuasive overall claims. Established Group ability on these terms makes this the strongest comparative lay case.

original_pre_race_assessment.summary: Liceo finished ahead of Max Meridius over this course and distance last week and meets him on unchanged handicap terms: 12 st against 11 st 6 lb. Max travelled strongly, went on, then failed to finish the race out. Liceo's repeatable recent hurdle form is the principal opposition.
original_pre_race_assessment.counterargument: Max Meridius looked ahead of his mark for much of that race and could reverse the result if settling better. Removing cheekpieces may help. His wide-margin October win at Thurles was on the Flat, not over hurdles.
original_pre_race_assessment.rival_limitations: Liceo has also been beaten repeatedly and must reproduce his recent effort. Deed Pole carries 11 st 7 lb after a 7 lb claim and has a Wexford hurdle third, but returns after 187 days. Phoenix Arizona carries 11 st after a 7 lb claim and is lower-rated over hurdles than fences, but must transfer chase ability. The direct recent Liceo comparison carries most weight.
